speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with an Asthma-COPD Overlap.

The spirometry results showing an FEV1/FVC ratio of 0.60 confirm a fixed obstructive pattern, which, combined with your 20-pack-year smoking history, is diagnostic for COPD. The worsening of symptoms at night and your history of seasonal allergies suggest a superimposed asthma component, often referred to as an asthma-COPD overlap. We will focus our treatment plan on managing both the obstruction and your allergic triggers.
